topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I can't believe it, the news just hit me like a punch in the gut. Your favorite spot, the one with the best pasta in town, is shutting down. Oh man, I wish I'd known earlier, maybe we could have done something, gone there one last time together. I remember how you always got the same dish, and the way you smiled when they remembered your order before you even said it. I feel like we've lost a part of our history, you know? Let's find a way to make it up, to carry on those memories in our own kitchen or something. Just let me know what you're thinking. I'm here for you, really.
